changes.to: Walden publishes no hardware specifications (checked 2026-11-17): its site describes a wheeled or fixed base with a humanoid upper body, two arms and a sensor head, running its Large Behavior Models (LBM 2.0, 'Sage') with remote assistance, and reports production work at a Toyota plant since February 2026. Height, weight, DoF, payload, speed, runtime and price therefore stay empty; catalogue figures such as 165 cm, 90 kg, 24 DoF or USD 120,000 are not maker values.

Wheeled dual-arm robot from Walden Robotics (a Toyota Research Institute spin-out) doing machine tending, tool setting, parts kitting and assembly in production, including at a Toyota plant in North America.
